% titletoc's run-in entries, \titlecontents*, in a book with hyperref:
% run-in chapters and run-in sections under them, beside a \dottedcontents
% subsection, and a chapter's partial table of contents from \startcontents
% and \printcontents.
\documentclass{book}
\usepackage{titletoc}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\titlecontents*{chapter}[0pt]{\bfseries}{\thecontentslabel\ }{}
    {\ \thecontentspage}[\ \textbullet\ ][.]
\titlecontents*{section}[1.5em]{}{\thecontentslabel\ }{}
    {, \thecontentspage}[;\ ][.]
\dottedcontents{subsection}[3.8em]{}{3.2em}{1pc}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\chapter{First chapter}
\startcontents
\printcontents{}{1}{}
Text of the first chapter.
\section{Gamma}
Text of gamma.
\subsection{Gamma one}
Text of gamma one.
\section{Delta}
Text of delta.
\chapter{Second chapter}
\section{Epsilon}
Text of epsilon.
\end{document}
